`class BlurShaderPass`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IShaderPass`](/reference/shaders/ishaderpass/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.pipeline.pass` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BlurShaderPass.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/pipeline/pass/BlurShaderPass.java)

Blurs the previous result along one axis; chain a horizontal and a vertical pass for a full blur.

- [Shaders](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/)
